notes: 37 entries checked on opened pages. 7 were in the wrong township (6 outside South Brunswick entirely), 1 more had stale address/phone, 2 had minor town/phone mismatches, and 1 chain survives the exclusions scan - all well past the FAIL threshold. Coverage is otherwise good: of the 21 in-zone eligible businesses my nine category searches surfaced, 19 were already listed (~90%), and nearly every apparent 'gap' turned out to be a North Brunswick, Franklin Park, Princeton, East Brunswick or Monroe firm sitting just over the township line (NJ Master Sewer, Any Auto Services, 27 Auto, Hollander Electric, Diamond Electrical, Almeida Electric, Lodi Handyman Pro, Lucky 17 Handyman, High Quality Painters, Sunlight Contracting, Standard Painting Services, Mehrovinci Contracting, Jireh Landscaping, Maple Tree Farm, Strong Contractor & Roofing).
data_gaps: alexanderplumbingheatingandcooling.com sat behind a Cloudflare bot check in the browser, so that entry was adjudicated from the Google place panel and BBB profile instead of the company site.
southbrunswickcontracting.com/contact/ is JavaScript-rendered and returned nothing usable; that entry's street address (135 Major Rd) is only corroborated by directories (cisleads, superpages).
Google Maps served an anonymous 'limited view' with about five results per query, so coverage is a ranked sample, not an exhaustive sweep; a closed list cannot be produced from it.

Five Star Plumbing & Heating, Right On Air Conditioning and Heating, Family Tree Care, A&C Tree Service and Kirkwood HVAC Repair Services surfaced in map results with no street address and could not be assigned to a township, so they were excluded from the coverage count rather than guessed.
One place panel was opened per disputed address; I did not re-check every one of the remaining ~40 entries' town labels, so the true error count in the list is probably higher than seven.
